ownershipAndIntegrationRequirements: No native calls, global world lookup, app config, public exports, accumulator or RAF. Existing integration and native sources were not edited.
Actual owner must supply an opaque JS identity per shared-body generation, not a native token; registerBody only registers logical identity and proves no actual native validity.

Actual owner/native must validate backend/full world and body generations, type/enabled/mass/pose/locks/arithmetic, capacities, unrelated-world-body readiness and counter readiness before apply; the queue only copies finite inputs and checks internal ownership/reduction.

collect receives an already-snapshotted stable callback roster. Continuous descriptor expansion/defaults/update and producer lifecycle remain future owner work; this module does not claim to implement public producer handles.
All input values copied once before enqueue. Same-queue nested mutating admission rejects; collection rejected submission stays latched even when callback/getter catches it or throws a falsy value.
Original accepted prequeue survives callback, read-only validation and known not-mutated apply refusal; provisional records are discarded. Sequence gaps are legal, never reused.

Known whole-batch commit retires all consumed records before a native tick completion notification. Postcommit readback/step/writeback failure cannot restore commands. Unknown apply quarantines immutable candidate and permanently faults queue until close.
CounterLimit is internal-only qualification input, default MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Diagnostics tickIndex becomes null at exhaustion. Protected zero uses no user sequence; cancellation consumes no sequence.
releaseBodyAfterTeardown is an owner-only notification requiring actual disabled/destroyed cleanup proof from future integration. Pure notification tests are NOT native lifetime evidence.

Pause clears accepted user records and keeps protected obligations. Future owner must separately suspend hooks/disable continuous producers and enforce transaction/event-dispatch/Node/material/component mutation fences.
